name: kiichi.
overview: Kiichi!! follows Kiichi Someya, a young boy whose childhood is shaped by loss, isolation, and his encounters with the harsh realities of Japanese society. As he grows older, Kiichi develops a fierce sense of justice and begins challenging the rules and institutions around him. The story explores childhood, alienation, social inequality, family, and the struggle between an individual's ideals and society's expectations. It is a dark, psychological coming-of-age story centered on a boy who refuses to simply accept the world as it is.
